card.name: Word-start pieces inside unusual names
card.fires_on: Short word pieces that begin or sit inside a rare name, a misspelling or a code, such as a single letter or digit after a hyphen or colon. Also single digits inside numbers and URLs.

modes.label: Start of foreign names
modes.description: A single capital letter or short piece opening an unusual place or plant name in a list.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of a dose, year or URL code.
